title: 18 loài cá / sinh vật biển mới cho Sobi Aquarium (mở rộng)
decisions: Expansion proposal 2026-10-16 (owner asked for more variety): 18 new species beside the 12 of aquarium-01-fish, same look rules (side view facing right, rarer = finer fins and richer colours). Sheet F3 = freshwater pond/home fish (COMMON/UNCOMMON, several Vietnamese), F4 = reef fish (UNCOMMON/RARE), F5 = sea friends incl. the baby dolphin (RARE/EPIC/LEGENDARY). Non-fish creatures still face right with their body trailing left. Content rows (content/aquarium/fish.json), manifest rows and K-derived ui_item_fish_* icons are added only after the owner approves the art; a LEGENDARY fish needs a balance decision.

sheets.name: F3
sheets.title: Cá Bảy Màu, Cá Neon, Cá Trê, Cá Sặc Gấm, Cá Bình Tích, Cá Chạch

cells.desc: Guppy: a tiny slim fish with a HUGE fan-shaped tail in sunset orange, pink and teal speckles
Neon Tetra: a small slim fish with one bright turquoise-blue stripe along its side and a red lower half near the tail
Catfish: a chubby grey-brown catfish with a wide flat head, a cream belly and four long droopy whiskers like a moustache
Honey Gourami: an oval honey-gold fish with a pearly dotted pattern and two long thread-like feeler fins hanging under its chest
Balloon Molly: a very round, balloon-bellied velvet-black molly with a big rounded tail and a soft silver sheen
Loach: a long wiggly sand-coloured loach with soft dark spots and tiny whiskers, body in a gentle S-curve

sheets.name: F4
sheets.title: Cá Đuôi Gai Xanh, Cá Bướm, Cá Đĩa, Cá Mao Tiên, Cá Vẹt, Cá Hộp

cells.desc: Blue Tang: an oval royal-blue fish with a dark curved stripe on its side and a bright yellow tail
Butterflyfish: a flat round lemon-yellow fish with white bands, a pointed little snout and a dark eye-spot near its tail
Discus: a perfectly round flat discus fish in turquoise with wavy red-orange lines, like a painted plate
Lionfish: a cute lionfish with a red-and-cream striped body and soft feathery frilled fins fanning out like a mane (rounded, not sharp)
Parrotfish: a chunky mint-green and pink parrotfish with a rounded beak-like mouth and big colourful scales
Boxfish: a cube-shaped yellow boxfish with black polka dots, tiny fins and a small pouting mouth

sheets.name: F5
sheets.title: Sứa Kẹo Bông, Rùa Biển Con, Cá Đuối Ó, Bạch Tuộc Con, Cá Rồng Kim Long, Cá Heo Con
sheets.notes: Cells 1, 2, 3 and 4 are sea creatures, not fish, but follow the same rules: seen from the side, heading to the RIGHT, with a cute small eye and a tiny smile.

cells.desc: Candy Jellyfish: a soft pastel pink-and-lilac jellyfish with a round dome bell and short wavy ribbon tentacles trailing to the left (colour only, no glow)
Baby Sea Turtle: a small sea turtle swimming to the right, mint-green shell with honey-brown plates, flippers spread like wings
Manta Ray: a gentle navy-blue manta ray with a cream belly edge, wide wing fins in a soft wave, heading right, thin tail trailing left
Baby Octopus: a round coral-orange baby octopus with a soft dome head and eight curly little tentacles trailing to the left, cream suction dots
Golden Arowana: a long majestic arowana with gleaming large gold scales, an upturned mouth with two small barbels and long flowing back fins
Baby Dolphin: a chubby smiling baby dolphin in soft sky-blue with a cream belly, a rounded beak, a curved back fin and a tail fluke, leaping slightly upward to the right
